groups.title: heart 忄 心
groups.note: The heart on the left or below: feelings and states of mind.

chars.story: A heart that keeps coming back to the same person: it longs for them.
chars.note: Mostly 'love' in the romantic sense.

chars.story: A heart threaded through the same routine until it feels natural: you are used to it.
chars.note: 习惯 is the word you will meet most.

chars.story: Things go 'not' the way the heart wished: sorrow.
A hooked thought tugs at the heart and pulls an old scene back.
chars.note: 忆 stands for 憶; the right side was simplified.

chars.story: A blade resting on the heart, and you grit your teeth: endure.
chars.note: 忍不住 means 'cannot help (doing)'.

groups.title: hand 扌
groups.note: Hand on the left: grasping, holding, handling.

chars.story: Hands wrapped around someone: a hug.
A hand darts into the storehouse and grabs what is inside: snatch.

chars.parts: 扌 hand + 圭 jade tablet (sound)
chars.story: A hand hangs a jade tablet on a hook.
A hand with an axe: snapped, it folds back on itself.
chars.note: Also 'discount': 打折 means 'on sale'.

chars.story: A hand sorts through old stock and puts each thing in order.
A hand clears everything away thoroughly: removed, pulled back.
A hand closes over a thing and keeps it sheltered inside: grasp.
Hands working over hemp back and forth: rub.
chars.note: Often a sound character in loanwords: 摩托 'motor'.

groups.title: water 氵
groups.note: Three drops on the left: water, tides, floods.

chars.story: Water spreading out thin over everything: extensive.
Water that comes in at the start of each day: the tide.
chars.note: 高潮 'high tide' also means the climax of a story.

chars.story: A paper ticket dropped on the water drifts away: float.
chars.note: You will meet it most in 漂亮 'pretty'.

chars.story: Someone slips under the water and out of sight: dive.

groups.title: person 亻
groups.note: A person standing at the left.

chars.story: A person slips away with what is not theirs: steal.
A person who towers above the rest: great.
chars.note: 伟 stands for 偉.

chars.story: A person acting with the right form and duty: a ceremony.
chars.note: 义 replaced the right side of 儀.

chars.parts: 亻 person + 顷 tilted head (sound)
chars.story: A person tipping their head to one side: leaning.

groups.title: numbers and measures
groups.note: Counting words you will meet in prose.

chars.story: The last few drops of rain, then nothing left: zero.
chars.note: Also 'odd bits' as in 零食 snacks.

chars.story: One person standing beside another makes two: times over.
chars.note: Counts multiples: 两倍 'twice as much'.

chars.story: Five people in a line: a squad.
Cloth unrolled to its full breadth: a width.
chars.note: Also counts pictures: 一幅画.

groups.title: money and property 贝
groups.note: Shell was once money; stone and grain go with it.

chars.story: Shell-money handed over in someone's place: a loan.
Shell-money coming in: you earn.
Money divided and divided until little is left: poor.
chars.note: 貧 became 贫: the shell 貝 is now 贝. His Analects card: 'poor'.

chars.story: Grain handed over for the use of land: rent.
Stone dug out of the hillside: ore.
The strength to walk down the dark passage first: brave.
A big man out in the field, working himself hard: he rouses himself.
chars.note: 奋 stands for 奮.

chars.story: A dragon sweeps down like a cloak over its victim: a raid.
A halberd swings and cuts the bird off in mid-air: cut off.
Stone does not give or change: it stays stiff.
chars.note: Also stiff, firm: 僵硬 is stiff.

groups.title: mood and manner
groups.note: Words that describe how someone is.

chars.story: A black dog slipping through the dark without a sound: silent.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'silently'. 默 also means 'write from memory'.

chars.story: A neat, fine-lined bird: elegant.
A good clear moon: bright and clear.
A mouth gaping wide like a valley, still lacking something: desire.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'want'. Modern use is mostly the noun 'desire'.

chars.story: Field work all day and thread still to spin: tired.
chars.note: 累 in 积累 means 'pile up'.

chars.parts: 虍 tiger head + 业 trade (shape)
chars.story: A tiger skin with nothing inside it: hollow.

groups.title: people and spirits
groups.note: Names for people and the beyond.

chars.story: Born from a woman: the line you carry, your surname.
The father of your father: grandpa.
chars.note: 爷爷 is the paternal grandfather.

chars.parts: 女 woman + 又 right hand
chars.story: A hand grips a woman and forces her to serve: a slave.

chars.parts: - a big-headed figure on legs with a trailing wisp
chars.story: A big-headed figure with a wisp trailing behind: a ghost.

groups.title: names and foreign sounds
groups.note: Most of these turn up in place names, surnames and foreign names.

chars.story: Lush grass spreading over an island nation: the Philippines.
chars.note: Mostly the Philippines (菲律宾) and a sound in foreign names. In old texts it can mean 'luxuriant, lush'.

chars.parts: 曰 (shape) + 罒 eye + 又 hand
chars.story: A hand stretches a long soft cloth across the eyes: long, soft, fine.
chars.note: Almost always a sound in foreign names.

chars.story: Fine earth drifting up into the air: dust.
chars.note: Also a sound in names: 埃及 Egypt.

chars.story: A herb cut in bundles and burned for healing: mugwort.
chars.note: A surname, and a sound in foreign names.

chars.story: Walking beside someone and showing them the way: enlighten.
chars.note: Mostly a sound in foreign names.

chars.parts: 王 jade + 山 mountain + 而 and (sound)
chars.story: A jade token kept on the mountain: a lucky sign.
chars.note: Sound in 瑞典 Sweden and 瑞士 Switzerland.

chars.story: A knife cutting a pattern: an old battle-ax, now the surname Liu.
chars.note: Almost always the surname Liu. 刘 stands for 劉.

chars.story: Dark millet fields before the day begins: first light.
chars.note: Also a surname, and in 黎巴嫩 Lebanon.

chars.story: Thread split into many strands: numerous and tangled.
chars.note: 纷 stands for 紛.

chars.story: Plain silk with nothing mixed in: pure.
chars.note: 纯 stands for 純.

chars.story: A thread pulled tight and gathered in: shrink.
chars.note: 缩 stands for 縮.

chars.story: Fire rising high: burning.
A fire held up on a nail-like stand: a lamp.
Fire in the head: bothered and vexed.

groups.title: food and plants 艹 米
groups.note: Grass on top, rice on the left.

chars.story: Green plants picked by hand: vegetables.
chars.note: Also 'a dish': 点菜 means 'order food'.

chars.story: A plant that gives dye: indigo blue.
Rice divided up fine: powder.
chars.note: 粉丝 is vermicelli, and also a star's fans.

chars.story: Good rice laid in store: grain, food supply.
The skin of the earth, tilted: a slope.
Packed earth built up to keep things in: a wall.
chars.note: 墙 stands for 牆.

chars.story: The side of the hill the sun misses: shade, cloudy.
chars.note: Also 'yin' as in 阴阳.

chars.story: War carts massed on the rise: a wave of attack, a burst.
chars.note: 阵 stands for 陣.

chars.story: The sun that suddenly slipped past: yesterday.
A day chopped short: temporary.
chars.note: 暂 stands for 暫.

chars.story: Sunlight falls right in the middle of a wall and shows an image: reflected.
chars.note: Shows up on a surface: reflected, projected on a screen.

chars.parts: - an ear with its rim and lobe
chars.story: An ear with its rim and its lobe.
chars.note: He has this shape from the Analects, where 耳 also means 'and that is all'.

chars.story: A mouth that juts out like a beak: the mouth.
chars.note: The everyday 'mouth' in speech (嘴巴); 口 is the written word and also an opening.

chars.parts: 冎 joint bone + 月 flesh
chars.story: Flesh wrapped around the knobbly joint: the bone inside.
A small wooden vessel cut from a tree: a cup.
Wooden shelves with slots for papers: files.
A branch offered into the hand: a stick.
chars.note: 真棒 'excellent' uses the stick as praise.

chars.parts: 讠 words + 旬 ten days (sound)
chars.story: Words put out over days to ask around: inquire.
Words that really come to pass: sincere.
Polished metal that shows your face: a mirror.

chars.parts: 钅 metal + 小 small + 贝 shell
chars.story: A small metal piece guarding the shell-money: a lock.

groups.title: roof 宀 and sickness 疒

chars.parts: 宀 roof + 艹 grass + 见 see
chars.story: A roof broad enough that you can see far across: wide across.

chars.parts: 宀 roof + 且 altar offerings
chars.story: Offerings laid out in good order under a roof: suitable.
chars.note: 便宜 means 'cheap'.

chars.story: A sickness whose signs show plainly: the illness.
Sickness blowing through like a wind: insane.
A knife cutting letters into a block for printing: publish.

chars.parts: 罒 net + 讠 words + 刂 knife
chars.story: Caught in a net, charged in words, met with the knife: punished.

groups.title: road 辶 and step 彳

chars.story: Steps beaten into the earth: a footpath.
Walking all the way through and cutting clean across: thorough.
Walking out to fetch someone to come along: invite.
Rain you can sweep up with a broom: snow.

chars.parts: 八 split + 人 + 口 mouth
chars.story: Slopes parting like a mouth: a valley.
chars.note: Also 'grain' (稻谷), where it replaces 穀.

chars.story: Tens of little mouths open along a branch: leaves.
chars.note: 叶 stands for 葉 and also is a surname.

chars.story: A person on their feet nodding the go-ahead: permit.

chars.parts: 礻 altar + 兄 elder brother
chars.story: An elder brother speaking at the altar: wishing.
chars.note: Also a surname.

chars.story: Eyes sweeping over the whole scene: view.
chars.note: 览 stands for 覽.

chars.story: The pin that holds the wheel and controls the cart: it has jurisdiction.
chars.note: 辖 stands for 轄.

chars.parts: - a seed splitting its hard shell
chars.story: A hard shell splitting open: plating, armor.
chars.note: Also 'first / party A': 甲方.

chars.parts: 亠 lid + 冖 cover + 方 direction
chars.story: Something covered over, with another at its flank: beside.
A roll curled up inside a boundary: a ring.
A mouth open wide showing teeth: an 'ah!'
chars.note: A softer, chattier 啊: 好呀 'sure!', 哎呀 'oh dear!'.

sentences.en: I was very tired last night.
I was secretly in love with him.
The picture is hanging on the wall.
Bangkok is the capital of Thailand.
He earns three times more than me.
Great is the power of habit.

sentences.zh: 是呀，这个很漂亮。多少钱？
sentences.en: Yes, this one is very nice. How much does it cost?

sentences.zh: 广泛的安全措施实施了。
sentences.en: Broad safety measures were put into effect.

sentences.zh: 埃尔多安是土耳其总统。
sentences.en: Erdogan is the President of Turkey.
